examples.description: Show sales pipeline stages as a funnel; edit a cell and the chart follows.

examples.description: Compare products on five criteria; each criterion is an axis, each row a polygon.

examples.title: Parallel coordinates
examples.description: Compare cars on five numeric axes; each row is one polyline.

examples.description: Show activity by weekday and hour as colored cells; edit a cell and the colors rescale.

examples.title: Sankey
examples.description: Show budget flows as links between nodes; a cycle is reported as an error.

examples.description: Follow a share over twenty days; open, high, low and close draw one candle per row.

examples.description: Compare score distributions of five teams from min, q1, median, q3 and max.

examples.title: Sunburst
examples.description: Show a company budget three levels deep as concentric rings; edit any branch and zoom by click.
